text:
leo: quick flag  In staging we got split rows in the usage heatmap when clients send both X-Tenant and X-Project. Which one should win for billing and for console breadcrumbs?

anya: historically the auth service canonicalized to Tenant (org) first. that surprised billing last quarter.

jordan: paste the failing event? i want to see headers + auth mapping.

leo: here's the request we replayed: 
```
{"path": "/v1/chat", "headers": {"X-Tenant": "tn-777", "X-Project": "pj-314", "Authorization": "Bearer bk_abc123"}}
```

kevin: are SDKs mutating to include X-Tenant for analytics? that could cause duping during a rollout.

anya: yes, some older SDKs inject X-Project and newer mobile lib adds X-Tenant. both shipped during migration, so many requests now carry both.

jordan: operationally we need two orthogonal truths: a) billing identity (project) b) org breadcrumb for console. they don't have to match.

leo: problem is quota enforcement lives in the router and expects a single tenant key. if we record two, enforcement may break.

kevin: suggestion: resolve a single enforcement key but persist both as metadata. resolution rules: 1) If API key maps to a project -> enforcement uses auth_project. 2) If API key maps only to an org (no project) and X-Project present -> treat header as fallback but tag as unverified_header. 3) If header_project != auth_project -> drop header for enforcement and increment metric auth.header_conflict.

anya: +1. also we should add a shim in the proxy to emit both resolution variants to logs for sampled traffic so we can compare counts before turning on the new behavior org-wide.

jordan: define metrics: auth.identity_resolution{org,route,reason} and auth.header_conflict_total. also a gauge for percent_unverified_headers.

kevin: security note: fallback must be denied if the key is bound to a different org. otherwise a spoofed header could misroute billing. explicitly: if auth_org != header_org and auth_project exists -> ignore header.

leo: console UX: show "Billing project (resolved)" as the main column in usage table, then an optional drilldown showing "Observed headers" and "auth-mapped identity". avoid showing two main rows.

anya: rollout plan: implement resolver in auth-service, add a proxy sampling flag to log dual-resolve, wire metrics, add console toggle per-org feature flag identity.resolve.v1, canary 10% orgs, monitor mismatch_rate < 1% before 100% enable.

jordan: can we get an env toggle to enable for a specific org for the partner demo?

anya: yes, we can gate by org id in staging and prod for a short demo window.

kevin: CI/infra work: i'll add the histogram + counter to prometheus exports and add a small alert if auth.header_conflict_total spike > 100/min.

leo: docs: need a short support blurb explaining "unverified header" and steps if customers see changed billing rows.

ci-bot: pipeline: feature/identity-resolver -> staging (build #9821) queued. :gear:
